ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. No full stops
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

2. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goes
   C. goed
   D. went

3. When practising Letter sound knowledge, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Letter sound knowledge.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Letter sound knowledge.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Letter sound knowledge.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Letter sound knowledge.

4. When practising Language structures School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language structures School.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language structures School.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language structures School.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language structures School.

5. When practising Pre- Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pre- Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pre- Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pre- Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre- Writing.

6. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

7. When practising Connected text reading and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Connected text reading and fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text reading and fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text reading and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text reading and fluency.

8. When practising Pre-reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre-reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pre-reading.

9. When practising Pronunciation and Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

10. When practising Word reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word reading.

11. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the Library

12. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

13. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only a joining word
   D. Only an action

14. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. blue
   C. happiness
   D. quickly

15. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Pre- Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
